positions.name: CalibrationSettling
positions.frame: how is the instrument calibration established and ratified as settled?
positions.why: Both expressions cohere around the same calibration outcome — src-1 performs the verification claim (88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates, holds across the full observing band) while src-2 ratifies that same outcome as a settled decision. The conviction gradient from unhedged claim (src-1) to performed decision (src-2) is the tension the frame holds: one expression asserts the calibration, the other records it as decided, and both share calm-positive affect, technical register, present-realis-concrete stance, and competence as the load-bearing value.
